search_name: Kerberoasting, Pass-the-Hash, and Tier-0 Lateral Movement Chain
rule_name: Access - Lateral Movement and Privilege Escalation Correlation - Rule
use_case_label: Lateral Movement and Privilege Escalation via Pass-the-Hash or Kerberoasting
incident_timeline: 2026-06-04T20:41:02Z DC01 4769 - 38 RC4 TGS-REQs for HTTP/svc-sqlagent from CORP\svc-backup
2026-06-04T20:48:15Z jump-01 4624 logon_type 3 NTLM key_length 0 pass-the-hash indicator
2026-06-04T20:55:17Z db-prod-01 4624 logon_type 10 RDP from jump-01 as CORP\svc-backup
2026-06-04T21:02:33Z db-prod-01 Sysmon 3 SMB 445 connection to dc01.corp.local

lateral_movement_technique: Pass-the-Hash followed by interactive RDP to Tier-0
privilege_escalation_technique: Domain Admin session established after Tier-0 access
drilldown_search: index=wineventlog (host=db-prod-01.corp.local OR host=jump-01.corp.local OR host=dc01.corp.local) user="CORP\svc-backup" earliest=-4h
hunting_query_spl: index=wineventlog EventCode=4769 TicketEncryptionType=0x17 | stats count by user service_name | where count > 10
hunting_query_kql: DeviceLogonEvents | where LogonType in (3,10) and AccountName == "svc-backup" and RemoteDeviceName has "db-prod"
risk_message: Service account svc-backup performed Kerberoasting against svc-sqlagent, pass-the-hash logons, and after-hours RDP to Tier-0 db-prod-01 culminating in da-admin privilege assignment.
description: CORP\svc-backup generated 38 RC4 Kerberos TGS requests for HTTP/svc-sqlagent, then used NTLM pass-the-hash (key_length 0) from jump-01 to reach db-prod-01 via RDP. Follow-on SMB and WinRM connections touched dc01, and special privileges were assigned to CORP\da-admin. No PAM session or change ticket exists; Rubeus-like tooling was observed on the Tier-0 host.
